citation.authors: Watanabe S, Okoshi H, Yamabe S, Shimada M

cited_by.title: Moringa: blood sugar, blood pressure and general health

record.design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of animal studies
record.finding: Extracts of Moringa oleifera lowered blood glucose in diabetic rodents (pooled effect size -3.92) with substantial heterogeneity, and improved triglycerides and cholesterol.
record.note: Animals only; large effects in rodents are common and have not carried over to people in the human trials above.
